promptRules: The 'Brick Boys' (Brick Bois) refers specifically to the veteran syndicate of Lang Buddha, Jean Paul (X), Marty Banks, and Tony Corleone.
Recognize and classify all squad configurations across the stream:
- 4-Man Full Squad: When all four are together (major heists, Mr. Cement challenges, convoy rides, hideout assemblies).
- 3-Man Trios: All 4 combinations (Buddha+X+Marty, Buddha+X+Tony, Buddha+Marty+Tony, X+Marty+Tony).
- 2-Man Duos: All 6 combinations (X+Marty for crime/ATMs, Buddha+Tony for taxi/business, Buddha+X, Marty+Tony, Buddha+Marty, X+Tony).
Treat the moments where 2-man duos rendezvous back into the full 4-man squad as major story milestones.
Prioritize the dynamics, operations, banter, and joint criminal ventures of these four core members as the primary narrative spine of the recap.

Whenever members of the crew interact (e.g. convoy rides, hideout meetings, Mr. Cement challenge, Burger Shot banter, crypto buying), treat the moment as a high-priority scene and ensure all present members are listed in 'participants'.
Distinguish clearly between each of the four characters and resolve their nicknames to their canonical names.
